## Integration checklist

- [ ] Exact diff and file list reviewed by the assigned chair
- [ ] Checks, acceptance evidence, and stated test limits recorded
- [ ] Shared-file coordination and required reviews resolved
- [ ] No secrets, customer data, restricted backend code, or unintended packaged files

The assigned chair may merge a scoped PR after these checks pass, subject to GitHub permissions and repository rules. Record unresolved release or restricted-service dependencies without claiming they passed.
